integrity: The universal claim rests on explicit algebraic and local analytic proof; ten exact symbolic sample checks are supplementary, not infinite certification. Same-model review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary projective closure of the Newton-power-sum plane model over C, n>=11 with gcd(n,6)=1. Does not classify analytic moduli beyond branches and contact, integral reduction, or branch arithmetic. Priority comparison remains qualified by unindexed classical treatments and unindexed classical models of Newton power-sum plane curves.
title: Branch-contact classification at infinity for symmetric Fermat quotient plane models
